errorCodes.meaning: No live session with this `sessionId` belongs to the proven issuer. Returned alike for a session that does not exist, one that has expired, and one that belongs to someone else, so the code cannot be used to probe sessions.
The session is already at or above the requested assurance level.
The holder has started too many step-ups for this session recently.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

approveRequest.description: A complete, signed auth/step-up/approve-request/0.5 document for this session: issuer the relying party, recipient the approver. The approver verifies it on its own terms; the framework-level envelope members are modelled here so none are lost on receipt, but `payload` and `proof` are carried opaque (unpacked and re-validated by that spec, not by this one) so the proof survives.

payload.description: The auth/step-up/approve-request/0.5 payload, opaque here — see that spec for its shape.

proof.description: A W3C Data Integrity proof (SPEC §4.7), opaque here — the approver verifies it on its own terms.
